headline.en: Rodri trained in the gym away from the main group on Saturday
headline.es: Rodri trabajo en el gimnasio, fuera del grupo, el sabado

summary.en: SPORT reported from the Ciutat Esportiva that Rodri trained apart again on Saturday and did gym work. The club wrote that plan when he arrived after the World Cup. His minutes against Athletic Club were the first public look at him in a Barcelona shirt this season. They were not a sign that he is ready for a full week of sessions. Flick wanted a managed return. That is still the plan.
summary.es: SPORT conto desde la Ciutat que Rodri volvio a trabajar al margen el sabado y hizo gimnasio. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron la primera foto, no la prueba de que ya aguanta la semana.

body.en: Rodri's transfer was the largest midfield outlay of the summer. The temptation is to treat every cameo as integration. Athletic was a 2-0 win in which he appeared after the game was already leaning Barcelona's way. Saturday's session put him back on the specific plan rather than in the main rondo. That is consistent with a player who had a World Cup summer and a short pre-season at a new club. Pedri is already carrying midfield minutes while Gavi is managed after Elche. If Rodri is rushed into Rayo and then into the first European midweek, the club will spend October explaining a muscle problem instead of a midfield trio.

tweets.name: Pol Ballus
tweets.text: Managed minutes. That is the Rodri story this week, not the fee.

tweets.text: Barcelona are still loading Rodri in stages after the World Cup.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Julian Alvarez. The decree is not an agreement
headline.es: El Atletico no vende a Julian Alvarez. El decreto no es un acuerdo

summary.en: Atletico Madrid still refuse to negotiate Julian Alvarez with Barcelona. Ramon Fuentes wrote in Mundo Deportivo that Spanish decree 1006 would not automatically sanction the player or the club if he tried to force a departure. That is a legal reading, not a bid and not a contract. Flick, Deco and Laporta have already said they will not chase a centre-forward Atletico will not sell. Raphinha and Ferran Torres remain the reference in attack.
summary.es: El Atletico sigue sin negociar a Julian Alvarez. Fuentes escribio que el decreto 1006 no sancionaria de forma automatica. Es un marco legal, no una oferta.

body.en: The Alvarez file has two layers that keep getting mixed. One is football: Flick has lined up without a classic nine and has used Raphinha as the high reference. The other is law: Fuentes argues a forced exit would not trigger automatic sporting sanctions under decree 1006. Useful if the story becomes a dispute. Useless as a transfer plan. Atletico's public line has not moved. Until that changes, treat every Alvarez headline as context around a team that is already playing without him.

headline.en: Barcelona host Rayo Vallecano on Monday at 21:30. Gavi missed Saturday training
headline.es: El Barca recibe al Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Gavi no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Barcelona play Rayo Vallecano at Camp Nou on Monday at 21:30, the first midweek Liga match of the title defence. Mundo Deportivo reported that Livakovic joined Saturday's session and Gavi did not, after the knock he took at Elche. Pedri has already covered that midfield role against Athletic. Two wins from two look comfortable on the table. They will look thinner if Gavi's knee swells overnight and Rodri stays on a gym plan.
summary.es: El Barca juega contra el Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Livakovic si estuvo el sabado y Gavi no. Pedri ya cubrio ese puesto.

body.en: Rayo are the first Liga side this season likely to defend in a low block and attack the channel behind the full-backs. Elche were beaten 5-0. Athletic were beaten 2-0 and still needed Unai Simon to keep the score down. Monday is a different test of distances. Gavi's absence from the last full session is availability news. Pedri can start. The club would prefer not to ask him to start every third day into September.
